description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SecurityNotAllowedMethodError' used within the Twig templating engine's sandbox security module. The class extends a base security error and is thrown when an disallowed class method is invoked in a template context.

classes.name: SecurityNotAllowedMethodError
classes.description: An exception class indicating an attempt to invoke a method that is not permitted during template sandboxing in Twig.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message, class name, and method name.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the name of the class where the method call was attempted.

methods.name: getMethodName
methods.description: Returns the name of the method that was attempted to be called.
